tha-ap4:1.1: Mahā-Moggallāna.] Anomadassī bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / vihāsi Himavantamhi devasaṅghapurakkhato. // //
tha-ap4:2.1: Varūṇo nāma nāmena nāgarājā ahaṃ tadā / kāmarūpī vikubbāmi mahodadhi nivās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap4:3.1: Saṅganiyaṃ gaṇaṃ hitvā turiyaṃ paṭṭhapes' ahaṃ / sambuddhaṃ parivāretvā vādesuṃ accharā tadā // //
tha-ap4:4.1: Vajjamānesu turiyesu devā turiyāni vajjiṃsu / ubhiṇṇaṃ saddaṃ sutvāna buddho pi sampabujjhatha. // //
tha-ap4:5.1: Nimantayitvā sambuddhaṃ sakaṃ bhavanam upāgamiṃ / āsanaṃ paññapetvāna kālam ārocayim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap4:6.1: Khīṇāsavasahassehi purato lokanāyako / obhāsento disā sabbā bhavanam me upāgami. // //
tha-ap4:7.1: Upaviṭṭhaṃ mahāvīraṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ / bhikkhusaṅghaṃ santappesiṃ annapānen' ahaṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap4:8.1: Anumodi mahāvīro sayambhu aggapuggalo / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap4:9.1: Yo so saṅghaṃ apūjesi buddhañ ca lokanāyakaṃ / tena cittappasādena devalokaṃ gamissati. // //
tha-ap4:10.1: Sattasattatikkhattuñ ca devarajjaṃ karissati / paṭhavyarajjaṃ aṭṭhasataṃ vasudham āvasissati. // //
tha-ap4:11.1: Pañcapaññāsakkhattuṃ ca cakkavatti bhavissati / bhogā asaṅkhiyā tassa uppajjissanti tāvade. // //
tha-ap4:12.1: Aparimeyye ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma gottena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap4:13.1: Nirayā so cavitvāna manussattaṃ gamissati / Kolito nāma nāmena brahmabandhu bhavissati. // //
tha-ap4:14.1: So pacchā pabbajitvāna kusalamūlena codito / Gotamassa bhagavato dutiyo hessati sāvako. // //
tha-ap4:15.1: Āraddhavīriyo pahitatto iddhiyā pāramiṅgato / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap4:16.1: Pāpamittopanissāya kāmarāgavasaṅgato / mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi ghātayiṃ duṭṭhamānaso. // //
tha-ap4:17.1: Yaṃ yaṃ yon' upapajjāmi nirayaṃ atha mānusaṃ / pāpakammasamaṅgīnaṃ bhinnasīso bhavām ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap4:18.1: Idaṃ pacchimakaṃ mayhaṃ carimo vattate bhavo / idhāpi ca 'disaṃ mayhaṃ maraṇakāle bhavissati. // //
tha-ap4:19.1: Pavivekaṃ anuyutto samādhibhāvanārato / sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap4:20.1: Dharaṇiṃ pi sugambhīraṃ bahalaṃ duppadhaṃsiyaṃ / vāmaṅguṭṭhena khobheyyam iddhiyā pāramiṃgato. // //
tha-ap4:21.1: Asmimānaṃ na passāmi māno mayhaṃ na vijjati / sāmaṇere upādāya garucittaṃ karom' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap4:22.1: Aparimeyye ito kappe yaṃ kammaṃ abhinīhariṃ / tāhaṃ bhumiṃ anuppatto patto 'mhi āsavakkhayaṃ. // //
tha-ap4:23.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap4:24.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
